newsitem.title: FRANCE: Frenchman jailed for arson at Turkish restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Frenchman jailed for arson at Turkish restaurant.

text.p: A French court jailed a 20-year-old skinhead for four years on Thursday for throwing a petrol bomb at a Turkish restaurant in the eastern city of Strasbourg.
The device started a blaze but caused no injuries as the restaurant had closed for the night.

Gregory Le Louarn, dressed in black and his head closely shaven, admitted the charge of premeditated arson and told the court there were too many foreigners in the town. Police said they found neo-nazi posters and swastikas at his home.
Le Louarn was also stripped of his right to vote or stand for public office for three years and ordered to pay 10,000 francs ($1,700) in damages to the League against Racism.
